fib: ______ is the funnel-shaped commencement of the ureter.
Renal pelvis

______ is a benign tumor; neuroblastoma is a malignant tumor.
Pheochromocytoma
Pheochromocytoma is a benign tumor; neuroblastoma is a malignant tumor.

Human Anatomy (II)
Human Anatomy
II

______ are those that are made of amino acids or proteins.
Non-steroid hormones
Non-steroid hormones are those that are made of amino acids or proteins.
______ can be defined as chemicals secreted by a cell that affect the functions of other cells.
Hormones
Hormones can be defined as chemicals secreted by a cell that affect the functions of other cells.
______ is composed of endocrine glands, which are ductless glands secreting chemical messengers into the circulatory system.
endocrine system

adrenal medulla

______ is a triangular area on the interior of the base of the bladder.
Trigone

hypothalamohypophyseal portal system
The hypothalamohypophyseal portal system is one of two major portal systems.

urinary bladder
